title: Joule Heating
theory: $P = IV = I^2R = \dfrac{V^2}{R}$; energy $= Pt$. In induction problems the resistor is the **energy sink**: gravity's terminal-speed power (2015-Q2-(5)) and the constant-speed pulling power (2018-Q2-(5)) both equal $I^2R$ — verified inside those solutions. Whenever an exam asks "where did the energy go?", the answer is the resistor, and the audit equation is one line.
